scope: apps/mobile/{app,components,lib}/**/*.{ts,tsx}, excluding *.spec.* and *.test.* (633 files); store/, assets/, test/ and node_modules are outside these three directories. All commands run from the repo root with ripgrep 14.1.

phone_rules.name: emoji
phone_rules.what: no colour emoji in any string, JSX text or template (specs exempt)

phone_rules.name: systemMenu
phone_rules.what: no ActionSheetIOS import, no import of */action-menu, no Alert.alert whose array argument has 3+ elements

other_mobile_guards: no-restricted-imports: KeyboardAvoidingView, BottomSheetScrollView/FlatList, 7 non-Expo-Go native modules
no-restricted-syntax: dynamic import() of those native modules
lint.note: Web has 6 named rules (emoji, tailwindBareVar, nativeDateTime, nativeSelect, browserDialog, moreMenu); the phone has 2. Nothing on the phone lints eyebrows, chips, abbreviations, button width, radii, Save buttons, pickers or haptics.

rules.method: rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' 'eyebrowStyle\(' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib; rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' '<SectionHeader\b' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib; rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' 'textTransform:\s*["\x27]uppercase' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib; rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' '^\s*\{?[A-Za-z_.\[\]]+\.toUpperCase\(\)\}?$|label=\{[^}]*\.toUpperCase\(\)' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib; rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' 'letterSpacing[:=]\s*\{?(0?\.[1-9]|[1-9])' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib
rules.precision_note: Sum of five greps: eyebrowStyle() spreads 19 (incl. list-section.tsx's SectionHeader style), <SectionHeader> JSX call sites 56, own textTransform uppercase 4, JS .toUpperCase() on a rendered label 4, positive letterSpacing 11. All hand-checked: positive letterSpacing includes 2 code-entry fields (email-code-sign-in 8, manual-code-sheet 1) and host-check-in's code (1) plus 2 SVG wordmark attrs in chat-background.tsx, which are not labels (5 false positives). A file can be counted under two greps (e.g. eyebrowStyle + own letterSpacing).

rules.rule: Row metadata is one muted meta line, not 2+ chips
rules.method: rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' '<(StatusChip|HairlineChip|AccentChip)\b' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib  (keep files with count>=2)  UNION  rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' 'styles\.(chips|tags|pills|badges|chipRow|chipsRow|metaChips|tagRow)\b' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib
rules.precision_note: Proxy = files with >=2 StatusChip/HairlineChip/AccentChip JSX elements, or a plural chip-container style. Hand-verified 10 of the proxy files: TRUE chip soup in 2 (components/minutes/minutes-row.tsx: type chip + draft/recorded StatusChip + other tags in one row; app/(app)/suggested-tasks.tsx: Who and When chips under each suggestion row) and arguably components/directory/member-profile-screen.tsx (role and group chips, content not metadata). FALSE in 7: event-excuses, balance-card, service-hours, activity-row (the 2 chips are either/or branches), task-details + open-task-screen (a single chip in a chipRow), ask-proposal (fact rows named chipRow). when-times/repeat-options/coming-up-dates/minutes-editor/ask-steps are choice or suggestion chips, not row metadata. Regex cannot tell mutually exclusive branches from siblings.

rules.method: rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' '["\x27`>][^"\x27`<]*\b(pts?|hrs?|mins?|tmrw)\b[^"\x27`]*["\x27`<]|^\s*(hrs?|pts?|mins?)\s*$|-min\b' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib; rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' '(weekday|month):\s*["\x27](short|narrow)' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib; rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' 'toLocale(Date|Time)String\(|\.toLocaleString\(["\x27]en-US["\x27],\s*\{|Intl\.DateTimeFormat' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib; rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' '\b(formatGraduationYear|formatPointsChip|pointsChipLabel|eventLengthLabel|formatHoursLabel|formatMinutesExact|formatMinutesRounded)\(' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib
rules.precision_note: Four greps. (a) literal abbreviations in mobile strings: 7 (hrs/hr x4 lines in study/week-summary + lib/study/format, 'pts' placeholder, pt/pts on You, '-min grace', 'hrs' unit in log-hours-sheet); (b) Intl short weekday/month: 4 lines (lib/minutes/minutes-list.ts 'Sun 5:00 PM' and 'Oct 27', events-time-grid weekday column); (c) date/time formatters NOT via @repo/formatting (toLocaleDateString/TimeString/Intl.DateTimeFormat): 19 in 14 files; all long-form except (b); (d) call sites of shared helpers that EMIT abbreviations: formatPointsChip '+10 pts', eventLengthLabel '45 min'/'1.5 hrs', formatGraduationYear "'27", formatHoursLabel '2.1 hrs', formatMinutesExact/Rounded '2h 30m': 16. No date-fns anywhere. Undercount: copy that lives in @repo/validation / @repo/hooks / @repo/formatting is only caught through (d). Number-only toLocaleString() calls are excluded.

rules.method: rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' '\b(formatHoursValue|formatHoursLabel|formatTimer|formatPaddedStopwatch|formatServiceHours|formatMinutesRounded|formatMinutesExact|formatCountdown|eventLengthLabel|focusLine)\(|\bclock\(reading|Resend email in' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib
rules.precision_note: Every duration formatter call site, hand-read. Eight output shapes: (1) formatHoursLabel (apps/mobile/lib/study/format.ts) -> '2.1 hrs' / '1.0 hr' (You tab study + service rows); (2) formatHoursValue -> bare '2.1', followed by literal ' hrs' / ' of 5.0 hrs' in study/week-summary.tsx; (3) formatMinutesRounded (@repo/formatting) -> '2h 30m' / '45m' (study session-row, service-hours rows); (4) formatMinutesExact -> '2h 30m' (chat hours-card); (5) formatServiceHours (@repo/hooks) -> bare '2' or '2.5' then 'approved hours' / 'hrs' unit; (6) eventLengthLabel (@repo/validation) -> '45 min', '1 hr', '1.5 hrs'; (7) formatTimer -> '4:12' / '1:24:36' (study session-card, ask-dictation); local clock() in lib/study/focus-timer.ts -> 'Focus · 18:42 left'; formatCountdown in lib/events/format.ts -> '0:27' (three separate m:ss implementations); (8) sign-in 'Resend email in 30s'. Includes definitions.

rules.method: rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' '<SheetPrimaryButton\b' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib  PLUS hand-verified hand-rolled 48pt buttons (python block scan: style keys matching /button|cta|submit/ with height/minHeight and no width, alignSelf start/center/end or flex: 19 blocks in 16 files, saved in the method of this audit)
rules.precision_note: A column child stretches by default in React Native, so `width: '100%'` / `alignSelf: 'stretch'` greps miss almost all of it (39 hits, mostly images and gutters). Counted instead: SheetPrimaryButton call sites (43; the component is a 48pt full-width bar, components/sheet-scaffold.tsx:734) plus 4 hand-verified full-width hand-rolled primaries (check-in primaryButton, study start-card startButton, dues balance-card payButton, study session-card endButton with explicit stretch). Of the 19 block-scan candidates, 11 opened: 4 true (those), 7 false (36pt buttons inside rows: suggested-tasks, ask-in-channel, event-excuses, chat-card, catch-up x2, member-profile messageButton). Auth/onboarding listed separately in auth_onboarding_files: OnboardingPrimary/SecondaryButton call sites 22 in 14 files (allowed by the rule).

rules.rule: Create actions use ScreenShell createAction / FloatingCreateButton / tab-bar +
rules.method: rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' '<PlusGlyph\b' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib; rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' 'label=\{?["\x27](New|Add|Create|Invite) [a-z]|label: ["\x27](New|Add|Create) [a-z]|NEW_LINK\}|MEETING_START_COPY\.start\}|MINUTES_FLOW_COPY\.start\.byHand' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib  (then drop the label lines that sit inside a createAction prop: tasks.tsx, events.tsx)
rules.precision_note: Proxy: inline PlusGlyph outside the shared create button, and New/Add/Create/Invite labels on a control. Compliant baseline: createAction on 5 screens (documents, events, minutes, service-hours, tasks). Hand-read every proxy hit. Real inline/header create controls: Chat home per-section '+' New channel IconButton ((tabs)/index.tsx:1092) and its empty-state InlineNote action (:978); Messages header pencil 'New message' ((tabs)/messages.tsx:377); chapter-roles.tsx:288 inline + row; directory.tsx:583 mounts FloatingCreateButton directly (not through ScreenShell; label 'Invite members') and :385 'Add roles'; You tab ListRows 'Create a chapter' / 'Invite members' (you.tsx:440,454); chapter-link-section 'New link'/'Make a new link'; meeting-actions and minutes-details 'Write minutes' buttons; event-agenda 'Add an item' row; minutes-editor add rows; activity-editor +; member-profile '+ Add role' / '+ Add to group' chips. Sub-record adds (agenda item, subtask, poll option) are arguably not page-level create actions.

rules.rule: State facts; no narrated or directive copy
rules.method: rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' '["\x27`>][^"\x27`<]*(\bTap\b|\btap (it|them|one|\+)|to get started|\bYou can\b|\byou can\b|Tell (the|your|an)|Ask (an?|your) (admin|officer|treasurer)|send it back|not posted yet|appear here|Pull down to|Press and hold|Long-press|In Settings, tap|Pick another)' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib  (drop lines containing accessibilityHint; that is the directive-string count)  ALSO state-surface usage: rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' '<ErrorState\b' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib ; rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' '<InlineNote\b' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib ; rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' '<NoChapterState\b' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib ; rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' '<CardMessages\b' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib
rules.precision_note: count = directive strings matched by the phrase regex after dropping screen-reader hints and 2 code lines (47 in 35 files); roughly 44 are real user-visible directions, the rest are error recoveries where a direction is arguably the fact ('In Settings, tap Location…'). Separately, state-surface usage (the places such copy lives): ErrorState 47 call sites (title + body props), InlineNote 56, NoChapterState 7 (always directive: 'Tap the chapter menu…'), CardMessages 5; there is no component named StateBlock, state-block.tsx exports ErrorState, NoChapterState and the skeletons. Undercount: most empty-state and status copy is imported from @repo/validation constants (EVENTS_COPY, TASK_AUDIENCE_COPY…) and never matches a mobile-only grep; 247 accessibilityHint props are excluded on purpose.

rules.rule: One action menu (glass menu); no system action sheet, 3+ button Alert or sheet of actions
rules.method: rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' 'ActionSheetIOS' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib; rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' 'showActionMenu\(' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib; rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' 'Alert\.alert\(' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib  (button count per Alert.alert by a balanced-paren parse of its third argument: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Frapp/41631046-a6cd-590e-a2ed-d83b352f1980/scratchpad/audit/alerts.py)  ; native menu libs: rg -n 'zeego|react-native-context-menu-view|@react-native-menu|action-sheet' apps/mobile/package.json (0 hits)
rules.precision_note: count = menu-like violations: Alert.alert with 3+ buttons or a mapped option list (5: linked-apps-section x2, series-scope, nudge-card, ask-proposal) + showActionMenu() call sites (7; lib/action-menu.ts is ActionSheetIOS on iOS and an Alert on Android) + its definition + 2 bottom sheets of actions (document-actions-sheet, composer-plus-sheet). message-actions-sheet is the rulebook's named exception. All Alert.alert: 82 calls in 48 files = 51 notices (title/message only), 26 two-button confirms or prompts, 5 menus. ActionSheetIOS appears in 2 files (lib/action-menu.ts, ask-proposal.tsx). No zeego/context-menu/@react-native-menu dependency. One RN <Modal> (task-photos.tsx lightbox, not a menu). Compliant side: useItemMenu() in 8 files, GlassMenu direct in 2 (chapter-menu, channel-filter-menu/channel-actions-menu via AnchoredMenuShell).

rules.rule: Picking a value is OptionSheet; no Save/Cancel; no hand-drawn radios; no chips as form picker
rules.method: rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' '^\s*<OptionSheet\b' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib; rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' 'accessibilityRole="radio"' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib; rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' '^\s*<FilterChips\b' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib  (minus actives-filter-sheet, which is a filter)  ; rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' 'doneAccent=|label=\{[^}]*"Save"\}' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib
rules.precision_note: count = hand-rolled picker sites: hand-drawn radio lists (13 sites in 12 files, excluding OptionSheet, Segmented and the two swatch pickers) + FilterChips used as a form field (8: repeat-options x3, new-task-sheet, log-hours-sheet, upload-document-sheet, new-poll-sheet, channel-form-sheet; plus when-times length chips counted under radios) + pickers/sheets with a Done or Save (9: TallSheetHeader doneAccent in who-picker, attendance, event Type, channel-access; Save in accent-sheet, status-sheet, edit-profile, member-class, member-correction, channel-form, scheduled-messages). OptionSheet itself is used at only 7 sites in 4 files (documents x4, task-follower, zone-picker-sheet, chapter-link-section). Full/near-full-height pickers (100% unless noted): who-picker-sheet, attendance-sheet, event-form-rows, pick-roles-sheet, member-roles-sheet, note-taker-sheet, channel-access-sheet, emoji-picker-sheet, gif-picker-sheet, actives-filter-sheet, member-class-sheet (member-class 88%); forward-sheet 85%, report reason sheets 85%. No expo-router modal routes exist. SheetHeader draws a 'Cancel' word wherever onCancel is passed: 28 sites. Dates/times use the platform DateTimePicker (8 files), which is the rule.

rules.rule: A sheet is one short pick or action; several sections is a pushed screen
rules.method: rg -l -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' '^\s*<(BottomSheetModal|OptionSheet|Modal)(\s|$)' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib  ; routes: rg -n 'presentation|formSheet|sheetAllowedDetents' apps/mobile/app (0 hits) ; per-file facts: python scan in the audit (snapPoints, useTallSheetProps, enableDynamicSizing, SectionHeader/ListSection counts)
rules.precision_note: Inventory, not only violations: 58 BottomSheetModal JSX sites in 57 files, 7 OptionSheet call sites, 1 RN Modal (photo lightbox), 0 expo-router modal/formSheet routes. Heights: 18 tall (100%), fixed 88% (edit-profile, member-class), 85% (forward, report-ai, message report), 65% (blocked-members), 60% (member-correction), computed (message menu), rest content-sized. count = sheets flagged as holding several sections (15): mechanical where SectionHeader+ListSection >= 2, plus forms judged by reading titles/structure (new-event, new-task, edit-profile, channel-form, new-form, new-signup, log-hours, upload-document, minutes-details, activity-sheet, actives-filter, channel-member). The judged ones were not all opened end to end; treat as candidates. Full table in `sheets`.

rules.rule: A list/section sits in a ListSection or an edged card, not on the page background; no card per row
rules.method: python: for each apps/mobile/app/**/*.tsx screen (no _layout, no spec) count <ListSection, <SectionHeader, *Row components, and surface refs /surfaces\.(card|raised)|pageSurfaces|useRaisedSurfaces|borderWidth/. Flag screens that render rows but have 0 ListSection and 0 surface refs. Card-per-row: scan components/**/*row*.tsx style key `row` for borderRadius+borderWidth+backgroundColor.
rules.precision_note: Proxy flags 10 (app) screens whose rows sit straight on the page: tasks, dues (rows under the balance card), notifications, study (history under the cards), events, directory, messages, chat home, arrange-channels, calendar-day. Opened 8 (tasks, dues, notifications, study, directory, messages, index, arrange-channels): 8/8 true, rows are hairline-divided HistoryRow/TaskRow/ChannelRow on the page background with a SectionHeader eyebrow and no edged group. Screens that do use ListSection: you, preferences, chapter-settings, chapter-roles, role, role-tier, minutes, minutes-series, minutes-details, documents (10). activity, service-hours and suggested-tasks draw their own edged cards. Card around every row: only components/auth/choice-row.tsx (64pt, auth) and the task grid tile (task-row.tsx `tile`); suggested-tasks rows carry their own borders (3 borderWidth) and may qualify, not opened. Chat home rows on the page are by design (Slack-style).

rules.rule: Loading draws the loaded shape; no centred spinner, no Loading… text
rules.method: rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' '<ActivityIndicator\b' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib; rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' '["\x27`>]Loading(…|\.\.\.)' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib; rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' '<Skeleton\w*|<\w+Skeleton\b' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib; rg -n  -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' '["\x27`>](Saving|Sending|Posting|Uploading|Starting|Deleting|Joining|Creating)…' apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib
rules.precision_note: count = ActivityIndicator JSX (25 in 24 files) + visible 'Loading…' text (2: message-thread-screen 'Loading…' older replies, scheduled-messages-sheet). Skeleton usage for contrast: 194 JSX sites in 56 files. Most spinners are inline busy marks inside a button or row (ListRow busy, SheetPrimaryButton, onboarding buttons, task-action-bar), not centred page spinners; opened 8: 2 centred/region spinners (image-viewer, thread-history-edge), 6 inline-in-control. Pending-verb labels that swap a button's text ('Saving…', 'Posting…'): 22 in 21 files, which the Pending rule ('gray text or a dim in place') may also cover. 50-odd 'Loading x' strings are SkeletonRegion accessibility labels and are excluded.

rules.rule: No hard-coded colours, sizes, radii, durations or weights outside the theme
rules.method: [hex] rg -n -o -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' "[\"'\`]#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}[\"'\`]" apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib ; [rgba] rg -n -o -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' "rgba?\(\s*\d" apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib ; [fontSize] rg -n -o -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' "fontSize:\s*\d+(\.\d+)?" apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib ; [borderRadius] rg -n -o -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' "border(Top|Bottom)?(Left|Right|Start|End)?Radius:\s*\d+(\.\d+)?" apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib ; [duration] rg -n -o -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' "duration:\s*\d+" apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib ; [fontWeight] rg -n -o -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' "fontWeight:\s*[\"'\d]" apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib ; [lineHeight] rg -n -o -g '*.{ts,tsx}' -g '!*.spec.*' -g '!*.test.*' "lineHeight:\s*\d+(\.\d+)?" apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/components apps/mobile/lib  (comment lines dropped)
rules.precision_note: Sum over seven categories (see `categories`): hex 15 in 9 files, rgba 17 in 9 files, fontSize 3 in 3 files, borderRadius 73 in 44 files, duration 10 in 8 files, fontWeight 15 in 12 files, lineHeight 5 in 4 files. The app is nearly clean on colour and type; borderRadius literals are the real drift (73 in 44 files, 21 distinct values against 7 radius tokens). Not caught by these greps: typeRole({size: N}) overrides (3: 11, 11, 9.5 badge sizes), named duration constants (FOLD_MS, SLIDE_MS… about 8; tokens.motion is referenced in only 3 files), and token arithmetic like tokens.spacing.xs + 2 (35 in 14 files).
